name: History of the English Language
description: The course explores the journey of the English language—from its early roots in Germanic dialects spoken by migrant and invading tribes to its current status as a global medium of communication. Students will be introduced to key texts from different periods (for example, old English, middle English, and modern English) and regions. The course will be centred around seminar-style discussions. Emphasis will be placed on analyzing shifts in grammar, vocabulary, spelling, and pronunciation, as well as exploring the sociocultural factors driving these changes. By examining language change in context, students will improve their ability to use English with greater clarity, flexibility, and cultural nuance.
